_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers — auto-loaded by Claude Code and other MCP clients that read .mcp.json from the repo root. Per-user keys/secrets live in env vars so this file is safe to commit. The persona entries (indigo-free/pro/admin/super) let an agent test the app as different user types — seed them with `bun run indigo personas`. Override or add personal servers in .mcp.json.local (gitignored).

indigo._comment: Default: acts as the superadmin created by `bun run init` (key auto-minted into .env.local). Or mint your own at /dashboard/settings/api-keys (mcp:invoke scope).

indigo-anon._comment: Logged-out persona — no credentials. Dev servers allow anonymous MCP access: public tools work, protected ones fail with UNAUTHORIZED (exactly like a logged-out visitor). Production always requires auth.

indigo-free._comment: Registered user, no subscription (free@test.local). Seed: bun run indigo personas.

indigo-pro._comment: Registered user with an active paid plan (pro@test.local).

postgres-dev._comment: Read/write SQL access to the local dev database. DO NOT enable in production. Pulls DATABASE_URL from the shell — same env as the app. If your local DB isn't running, this server fails to start and the indigo servers above still work.
